glossEn: a strip forming the outer edge of something
note: a strip forming the outer edge of something。线索：on / at the border of。也可指装饰性的「花边/镶边」（verb border 的名词面）。

glossEn: lie adjacent to another or share a boundary
note: lie adjacent to another or share a boundary。动词义。线索：border on / border a country。名词 border（国界）同属这条。

glossEn: provide with a border or edge
note: provide with a border or edge。现有中文无此义项，属新增。线索：bordered with plants。
[glossEn 空：ECDICT 与 WordNet 均无对应义位] [ZH-FALLBACK 英文零覆盖] 英文 a flower border 指沿路/沿墙的一条花带。ECDICT definition 侧无边界，走 fromZh 补洞，glossEn 留空。真实搭配但罕见。
